correctness.rationale: Acuaviva supplies a Dunford–Pettis projection with non-RNP Schur range. If it factored through l1, its range would embed isomorphically as a closed subspace of l1 and inherit RNP, a contradiction. Idempotence then places the same projection in every closed Dunford–Pettis power; the remaining ideal inclusions and quotient statements follow by explicit factorizations.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Nasseri's v1 states only separate nonvanishing of all quotient powers via Rajchman convolution powers and does not state a common idempotent or common large ideal. Acuaviva's v1 supplies the projection but does not connect it to the new power-ideal chain. Targeted literature and repository searches found no equivalent synthesis.

value.rationale: The result strengthens nonvanishing at every order to a persistent nonzero idempotent and a common proper large ideal in all powers. It also shows every operator-level power ideal is proper and large and that the quotient of the Dunford–Pettis ideal by representable operators is nonradical.
